message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Person Zhang (defendant) forged a document (a false official letter) to hide a prior bribery record of a colleague, to facilitate a bid. He printed a fake document, altered dates, spliced official seal, etc. This is forging, counterfeiting official documents. The relevant crime: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" (forgery of state documents). The correction lessons mention that label: 【伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章】 is correct for forging official documents. Also possibly "行贿" but the defendant didn't give bribe, he forged documents to hide prior bribery. The crime is forging official documents. Also maybe "职务侵占"? No. "虚假陈述"? Not listed. So label: 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章.

Check if any other label needed: Could be "行贿" because the underlying context is about bribery record, but the act is forging. The defendant didn't give bribe, just falsified record. So only forgery.

Thus answer: [罪名]伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
